verdict.rationale: The docs name a first-party 'Devin Review' feature with an Auto-Fix mode that 'fixes flagged bugs' and responds to code review comments, so an AI code-review capability exists. The evidence does not show that it runs automatically on every pull request or that it posts inline comments; the single mention is mostly about Devin acting on review feedback. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic triggering on every PR, AI-generated inline comment output, configuration or coverage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have every pull request automatically reviewed with AI-generated inline comments

citations.quote: Enable Devin Review with Auto-Fix so Devin automatically responds to code review comments, fixes flagged bugs, and iterates on CI failures
